description: A silent letter is merged into its neighbouring sounding unit when the combined spelling is listed here. Letter positions never change. Silent e units that form a split spelling such as a_e are handled first and are never merged here.

split_vowels.description: A single vowel letter, one consonant and a silent e form a split spelling, whether or not it is a defined lesson.

suffix_endings.description: Endings that win over other merges when they close a word, so the e in -ed and -es joins the final consonant.
